name: GRAMS
summary: Liquid-argon TPC project combining MeV gamma-ray astronomy and antimatter dark-matter searches; the complete observing mission must be distinguished from small prototypes.
detection_principle: Gamma-ray directions are reconstructed from Compton-scattering positions and energies; stopped antiparticles form exotic argon atoms, identified through X-rays and annihilation topologies.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
